messages.subject: Scheduled maintenance: document management system (Sat 16 Nov)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear all,

The firm's DMS will be unavailable on Saturday 16 November from 20:00 to 23:00 for scheduled maintenance and security patching. Please save and close all documents before 20:00. Email will be unaffected.

If you have any urgent access needs during the window, contact the IT duty officer.

IT Helpdesk
Whitfield Carter LLP
